description: This file is a shell script that defines functions for checking and repairing ext2/3/4 filesystems using e2fsck. It includes logic for handling different exit statuses and logging, as well as functions that wrap the core e2fsck calls. It appends filesystem types to a known list.

methods.name: fsck_e2fsck
methods.description: Performs filesystem check on a device using e2fsck with logging and status handling.

methods.name: fsck_ext2
methods.description: Wrapper for e2fsck check on ext2 filesystem.

methods.name: fsck_ext3
methods.description: Wrapper for e2fsck check on ext3 filesystem.

methods.name: fsck_ext4
methods.description: Wrapper for e2fsck check on ext4 filesystem.
